stable.label: scratch-deep-world-ci-pass
stable.note: The active deep-world foundation has fresh Codehood and Foundation CI evidence. The deployed browser/iPhone build after this architecture change is still not live/device tested.

active_experience.runtime: vanilla JavaScript modules + Worker + transferred OffscreenCanvas; no third-party runtime libraries
simulation_changes: a persistent chunked 2D world volume stores material identity, integrity, support, moisture, nutrients, temperature, water volume/velocity, oxygen, carbon dioxide and vapor
the deep volume is deterministically bound to the generated surface so visible geology, cave openings, organisms and navigation share world coordinates
the volume contains air, soil, stone, sand, clay, limestone, basalt and organic material rather than painted cave backgrounds
granular/weak material changes actual occupancy when unsupported or sufficiently unstable
underground water transfers conservatively through open volume cells and carries a velocity proxy
gas and heat exchange operate between connected open cells
chunks retain independent seed/LOD/active metadata and are activated around the camera and living organisms
ALife navigation uses A* over persistent material-volume walk cells instead of direct target chasing when the deep world is available
A* uses solid occupancy plus water, carbon-dioxide and temperature hazard cost, and supports physically supported one-cell stair transitions while rejecting diagonal wall clipping
default geology/cave/liquid rendering is extracted from discrete simulation occupancy into smoothed closed contours; the grid is not drawn as tiles
visible crawler bodies are generated from articulated rig state as continuous body envelopes, shell segmentation, tapered limb volumes, claws/feet and mandibles rather than circle-per-node graphics
render pose smoothing is presentation-only and never writes back into simulation state
approximations: this is a 2D material-volume simulation, not full 3D
deep liquid transport is a conservative cellular volume/momentum approximation, not Navier-Stokes, FLIP, SPH or MPM
surface ocean/river compatibility still uses the older 1D shallow-water state while some mass can leak into deep openings

the older Environment module remains temporarily active for cloud compatibility and some organism atmosphere/waste behavior; deep-world gas is not yet the sole authority for every atmospheric subsystem
the A* planner can compute cave-volume routes but the current articulated crawler motor is still optimized for ground travel and cannot yet execute arbitrary vertical cave traversal
chunk LOD/active metadata exists but deep-world stepping is not yet fully reduced/slept by chunk LOD
creature gait uses authored articulated stance/swing actuation rather than muscle physiology
ALife drive arbitration is not learning
smooth contour rendering visualizes discrete material state and does not increase simulation resolution

failed_deep_world_proofs.reason: obsolete first-frame speed test from prior planner
test assumed speed before deliberate steering commitment
A* fixture demanded an impossible route over unsupported vertical wall
A* anti-corner rule incorrectly rejected legitimate supported stair transitions

deep_world.truth: persistent 2D cells are simulation state; default renderer hides the grid behind extracted/smoothed contours

scratch_alife.note: The current ALife regression suite passed with the deep-world route planner, including sustained planted-foot locomotion along an active deep-world route.

scratch_environment.note: Standalone cave/gas/liquid tests remain valid for environment.js, but it is now a compatibility subsystem rather than the sole active world volume.

legacy_ecosystem_stack.note: Previous V100-V110 and patch layers remain in repository files/history but are not imported by the active scratch route.

active_objective: Unify atmosphere/waste/surface fluids into the deep world so there is one authoritative environmental state, then make chunk LOD actually reduce distant simulation and extend the physical motor to execute stairs, drops, climbing and cave traversal from the same A* route.
next_gate: Do not add civilization-scale complexity until one authoritative deep environment, real chunk scheduling and route-following motor traversal are causally integrated and freshly tested. LIVE_TESTED/DEVICE_TESTED still require deployed browser/iPhone execution.
invariants: No third-party runtime libraries in the active scratch engine
Active world simulation must use persistent state rather than decorative effects
Simulation cells may not be presented as visible block tiles in the default renderer
Physics nodes may not be rendered as circle-per-node creatures
Do not call the 2D material volume full 3D
Do not call cellular liquid transport CFD
Do not call authored gait muscle physiology
Do not call the ALife controller learning
CI_PASS does not imply LIVE_TESTED or DEVICE_TESTED
